task: Take the key, then open the door. After that, try to pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) hard is the last required step, and Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) hard forces the key first without a redundant Existence(has_door_key). Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard keeps the "after that" order, since the "try" cue covers only the box step, and Existence(target_picked_up) soft matches the preference. blocker_moved needs no clause because the environment constraints already make it precede door_open.
